supportProvenance.sampleDependency: Three.js 0.127.0 from unchanged unpkg URL; browser force-cache reread byte hashes recorded per application.
supportProvenance.threeApplication: r186 at 9b4a2ac29c63ccb43fd51c5661f2f873ac2c39b8; served build modules and XRPlanes from that revision.
supportProvenance.wpt: e1859580b5fcf74940a18d2f783296b4961035e3; six original plane tests retained; adapted real-extension assertions executed, not official fake-device WPT harness.

resolvedFailures.failure: Per-frame shape signature comparison discarded cumulative sub-tolerance shape changes.
resolvedFailures.correction: Regression first failed; retain last published signature, then pass all 13 environment tests and final browser matrix.

resolvedFailures.failure: Initial rectangle-pair merging left 1122.687 m² of proxies over 675.822 m² of source.
resolvedFailures.correction: Connected boundary strip partition preserves exact polygons and reduces measured proxy area to 732.510 m²; oblique proxy excess explicitly retained.

resolvedFailures.failure: API fixture created a cross-realm session layer/context in the wrong realm.
resolvedFailures.correction: Allocate canvas/context/layer in the session realm; no production layer behavior changed.

resolvedFailures.failure: Firefox injected Promise compared against the page Promise constructor.
resolvedFailures.correction: Check Promise identity via Object.prototype.toString and await actual resolve/reject behavior.

resolvedFailures.failure: Observer selected a co-located mesh with a different orientation.
resolvedFailures.correction: Choose closest full transform, then verify every geometry and transform component.

resolvedFailures.failure: Chromium observer attached after panel scene construction, and one configuration event preceded model readiness.
resolvedFailures.correction: Use existing bootstrap breakpoint observation and wait for real panel model readiness.

resolvedFailures.failure: Later scenarios retained viewer/phone controls from the previous scenario.
resolvedFailures.correction: Reset genuine controls and assert measured movement in every combination.

resolvedFailures.failure: Final cleanup assertion required the retained presentation layer wrapper to become null.
resolvedFailures.correction: Measure detached presentation canvas, empty live-layer registry, empty tracking/callbacks and exactly two end events.

resolvedFailures.failure: Full Chromium suite had stale bounded-floor pending-at-shutdown allocation assertion.
resolvedFailures.originalAssumption: Pending request can still allocate after shutdown.
resolvedFailures.correctedRequirement: Shutdown cancels requests already pending; independently initiated post-shutdown supported requests may still allocate.
resolvedFailures.reference: docs/webxr-reference-space.md retained Issue #41 correction and pinned Device shutdown algorithm.
resolvedFailures.rationale: Update the test to the existing implementation/spec reconciliation; no new runtime change.

unperformedChecks: Official native WebXR Test API WPT harness, manual capture and semantic labels: no sensor adapter; six tests are adapted assertions as documented.
Physical Quest/Android sensors and hardware certification; not required by this emulator task.
Other browser versions, universal coplanar merging, and additional optional irregular rooms.
Dynamic shape updates by the unchanged pinned XRPlanes helper: it only creates/removes meshes; tested at API level instead.
remainingLimitations: Plane polygons preserve the room; pinned rectangular proxies have 8.39% excess on oblique boundaries.
Deterministic within-mesh connected coplanar partition; no universal merging, semantic classifier or physical scanning.
Existing mesh binding/deferred-module work remains as documented in the inventory.
observationLimitations: The shared observeXR helper resets its viewport counters on each getViewerPose. The Sample calls that operation after its renderer has obtained viewports, so its retained width/height counters are zero; no positive viewport-counter claim is made. Public eye lists, positive captured per-eye presentation regions and identifiable application pixels are recorded. The Three application retains positive viewport counters.
